caption: The worked example gate by gate: H spreads |0⟩ into two equal amplitudes, Z puts a minus sign on the |1⟩ amplitude, and the closing H turns that hidden sign into the state |1⟩. Notice the minus in the third box — no 0/1 measurement can see it until the last H, after which P(0) = 0 and P(1) = 1.

spec.title: H then Z then H on |0⟩
spec.aria: A left-to-right chain of the four states in the worked example: |0⟩ with amplitudes 1 and 0, then |+⟩ with 1/√2 and 1/√2 after H, then |−⟩ with 1/√2 and −1/√2 after Z, then |1⟩ after a second H, where P(0) = 0 and P(1) = 1.
